items.title: 18.10.3 Copper(II) ion aur iodide ion ka reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the copper(II)-iodide reaction (PDF 34).

blocks.text: Jab copper(II) sulphate ke mehlool mein zaid potassium iodide milaya jaye to iodine ke surkhi maail bhoore mehlool mein copper(I) iodide ka safaid precipitate banta hai: 2Cu2+(aq) + 4I-(aq) -> 2CuI(s) + I2(aq). Half-equations yeh hain:

I2/I- jore ka E zyada hai, is liye sirf in qeematon par iodine ko reduce hona chahiye; Cu2+/Cu+ jore ka E kam hai, jo batata hai ke Cu+ I- se behtar reducing agent hai. Likhe gaye reaction ke liye E cell = 0.15 - 0.54 = -0.39 V, jo manfi hai. Phir bhi reaction aage barhta hai, kyunke banne wala CuI musalsal mehlool se neeche baith'ta hai. Is se product Cu+ nikal jata aur equilibrium daen taraf jata hai (Le Chatelier's principle).

blocks.title: Iodine ki paimaish
blocks.text: Banne wali iodine sodium thiosulphate ke mehlool se titration kar ke napi ja sakti hai: I2 + 2S2O3 2- -> 2I- + S4O6 2-.

blocks.prompt: Standard electrode potentials se redox reaction ke mumkin hone ka faisla karne ka usool batayein.
blocks.explanation: E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation) nikalein; agar E cell musbat ho to reaction mumkin hai. Zyada musbat E wala species reduce hota hai.

blocks.prompt: MnO4- (E = +1.52 V) aur Fe3+/Fe2+ (E = +0.77 V) ke liye oxidising aur reducing agents batayein.
blocks.explanation: MnO4- oxidising agent hai (reduce ho kar Mn2+); Fe2+ reducing agent hai (oxidise ho kar Fe3+).

blocks.prompt: MnO4- aur C2O4 2- ke reaction ka E cell nikalte waqt paani kyun shamil nahi hota, halanke mua'adle mein hai?
blocks.explanation: E cell sirf do standard electrode potentials se nikalta hai, jo pehle hi standard halaat mein mukammal half-equations se mutaliq hain; paani solvent hai, is ki miqdar amalan qaim hai, aur yeh hisaab mein shamil nahi hota.

items: CuI ka neeche baithna Cu+ nikal kar reaction chalata (Le Chatelier).
